description:
What this is. The clinic fills this in, not you, so this page is for reading. The important line is whether the person is fit for work, fit with some limits, not fit, or needs to go back for another check. It also lists anything the clinic found and how serious it is.

A guided tour. Opening this step walks you through the page one box at a time and explains what each one is for. You can start it again whenever you like with the small i button at the top of the page.

Where to find it. To see the ones already there, open Clinic Test Result from the menu on the left.
name: Read Clinic Test Results
title: Clinic Test Result — what the clinic found
